what: When the vision paragraph enters 15% into the area that excludes the bottom 25% of the screen, for each line folded on screen a pale gray layer rises in from 20px to the left over .8s sine.out at .1s intervals, and at the same time a dark layer covers from the left over 2.6s power4.inOut along a diagonal (slope 8%) where the upper side goes first, so the text is painted from gray to black. Plays once

options.fade: Duration of the line rising (s), default .8
options.dur: Length for the diagonal lines to clear away (sec), default 2.6
options.x: Sideways distance in px the line floats up from, default -20
options.--fx-from · --fx-to: Light layer and dark layer text colors (css variables), defaults var(--kf-dim) · var(--kf-ink)

use:
Your first sentence here
Your second sentence here
note: Lines are split not with line-break tags but into on-screen folded lines at paste time (Range rects), so lines wrapped on phones are also painted separately. Lines are not re-split when the width changes after pasting (same as the original)
